name: UNIQUE
description: UNIQUE returns the distinct values from a range or array, optionally returning only values that appear exactly once, as a dynamic array.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The range or array from which to extract unique values.

parameters.name: by_col
parameters.description: FALSE to compare across rows (default) or TRUE to compare across columns.

parameters.name: exactly_once
parameters.description: FALSE to return all distinct values (default) or TRUE to return only values that occur exactly once.

basicExample.description: Extract distinct values from a list
basicExample.result: Each distinct value from A2:A10, listed once
basicExample.explanation: UNIQUE removes duplicates and spills the distinct list.

advancedExamples.title: Values that appear only once
advancedExamples.scenario: Find items with no duplicates in a column.
advancedExamples.result: Only the values that occur exactly once in A2:A10
advancedExamples.explanation: With exactly_once TRUE, repeated values are excluded entirely.

advancedExamples.title: Unique across columns
advancedExamples.scenario: Distinct values in a single row.
advancedExamples.result: Each distinct value from the row A1:D1
advancedExamples.explanation: by_col TRUE compares values across columns instead of down rows.

howItWorks: UNIQUE returns the distinct values from array. By default it compares values down rows (by_col FALSE) and returns all distinct values. Setting by_col TRUE compares across columns; setting exactly_once TRUE returns only values that occur once. Results spill as a dynamic array.

howToSteps.name: Select the range
howToSteps.text: Pick the array with possible duplicates.

howToSteps.name: Ensure spill space
howToSteps.text: Leave empty cells below/right for the result.

limitations: Comparison is case-insensitive by default; 'Apple' and 'apple' are treated as equal.
Returns a spilled array, so it needs empty room below/right.

commonErrors.cause: No room for the spilled results.
commonErrors.fix: Clear the cells in the spill range.
Use a helper column with EXACT for case-sensitive uniqueness.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: UNIQUE is a native function in Google Sheets with the same behavior and a similar signature.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Sheets also supports UNIQUE(range, by_col, exactly_once) and is case-insensitive like Excel.

faq.question: Is UNIQUE in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes, UNIQUE is native in Google Sheets.

faq.question: How do I get only values that appear once?
faq.answer: Set the exactly_once argument to TRUE.

faq.question: Is the comparison case-sensitive?
faq.answer: No; UNIQUE treats 'Apple' and 'apple' as the same value.
